general-hypertrophy-v1.description: General, conservative coverage defaults; not an optimal prescription.

evidence.interpretation: Moderate repetitions (about 6-12) taken near failure drive hypertrophy per the loading continuum; RIR 2 anchors proximity to failure. Coverage targets are conservative generic defaults, not an optimal prescription.

general-strength-v1.description: Minimal generic strength defaults; exercise-specific strength programming remains out of scope.

evidence.interpretation: Low repetitions (about 3-6) at heavy loads bias maximal strength per the loading continuum; RIR 2 anchors proximity to failure. Exercise-specific strength programming remains out of scope.

general-endurance-v1.description: Higher-rep, lighter-load local-muscular-endurance defaults; endurance-specific weekly set-volume evidence is limited, so coverage is kept conservative and this is not an optimal prescription.

evidence.interpretation: Local muscular endurance sits at the high-repetition end of the loading continuum (roughly 15+ repetitions at lighter loads). RIR 2 anchors proximity to failure. Weekly set-volume targets for endurance are less well established than for hypertrophy, so coverage defaults mirror the conservative hypertrophy baseline.

commercial-gym-general-v1.description: Common commercial-gym convenience default; it does not guarantee local availability.
